name: UMSL Bridge Program Saturday Academy
org: University of Missouri-St. Louis, Office of Precollegiate Student Services
what_you_do: 9 Saturday mornings of math, science and writing workshops. Grades 9 to 10 get career planning. Grades 11 to 12 get college admissions and scholarship help. Seniors can earn college credit and UMSL scholarships.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 9 to 12 at a St. Louis area school with a 2.5 or higher GPA. You must be in or past Algebra. You need a transcript, a behavior report and a teacher or counselor recommendation.
pay_detail: UMSL's landing page calls its Bridge services free. No pay.
duration: First two Saturdays of each month, October to February, 7:45 a.m. to 12 p.m.
deadline_text: The page says the 2026-27 application is closed and lists an extended deadline of Sept 18, 2026, which has passed. 2027 application dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the UMSL Bridge page when it opens. Send a transcript, behavior report and recommendation form.
